pages.title: The Loom of Worlds
pages.text:
The skies were held by a lattice of living thread. Nine Strands, tended by nine tribes of Ninjacats, pulled taut across the whole sky.

Continents hung from it. Weather ran along it. Nothing fell that was not meant to.

pages.title: What the tribes made
pages.text:
From their shared pull on the Loom came **Tribal Power**: shamanic technomancy of pulse, lattice, seal, and the road into the March-lands.

The engines are still out there. Orphaned, humming, sacred. Treat them like an inheritance, not a scrap pile.
